signal: MODEL_0 false-to-true Stage 2 eligibility transition after the close
entry: next available session open plus 5 bps adverse slippage
atr_definition: 20-session simple mean of True Range through the signal date

execution.cash_and_notional_model: Normalized 1R sizing only; no portfolio cash or maximum-notional constraint

shortlist_rule: Discovery-only shortlist requires at least +0.10R expectancy versus baseline, profit factor no lower than baseline, maximum drawdown no worse than baseline, and support from an adjacent target or stop setting. It still cannot be promoted without independent validation.
constraints: Report all 20 combinations, not only the best result
Do not tune additional values after inspecting results
Do not evaluate the untouched 2024-2025 holdout
Do not change production logic from this experiment
